verdict.rationale: TeamViewer has a documented Web API (teamviewer-docs-1), but nothing shows that a machine-readable OpenAPI or equivalent spec can be downloaded. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404 (teamviewer-probe-2). Human-readable API docs are an adjacent feature and do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
